scope: New routes/system-notify-routes.js: a single requireKey-gated POST /email route that sends a plain-text email via Postmark using process.env.POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN and process.env.EMAIL_FROM (falling back to POSTMARK_FROM), never logging or returning the raw token.
platform_gap_fill_reason: GAP-FILL: founder-directed live need (Adam, 2026-08-10) to email himself a device-install link across an Apple/Android boundary that has no native share path -- not a pre-planned BP_PRIORITY queue item.

steps.title: Create routes/system-notify-routes.js
steps.task: The file MUST begin with a JSDoc block comment containing a line exactly '@ssot docs/products/universal-overlay/PRODUCT_HOME.md' (mandatory, checked by a commit gate). Create a new Express route module exporting a function createSystemNotifyRoutes({ requireKey, logger }) that returns an express.Router(). The router has one route: router.post('/email', requireKey, async (req, res) => {...}). Handler behavior: read { to, subject, text } from req.body. Read token = process.env.POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN and from = process.env.EMAIL_FROM || process.env.POSTMARK_FROM, trimmed. If token or from is missing, respond 503 { ok:false, error:'email not configured' } -- do NOT include the token value anywhere in the response. If to, subject, or text is missing/empty, respond 400 { ok:false, error:'to, subject, and text are required' }. Otherwise POST to https://api.postmarkapp.com/email using fetch, headers 'X-Postmark-Server-Token': token and 'Content-Type':'application/json', body JSON { From: from, To: to, Subject: subject, TextBody: text, MessageStream: 'outbound' }. Parse the JSON response; if the Postmark response is not ok, respond 502 { ok:false, error: (Postmark's Message field or the HTTP status) } -- never include the token in this error. If Postmark succeeds, respond 200 { ok:true, message_id: (the Postmark response's MessageID field) }. Wrap the whole handler body in try/catch; on a caught exception call logger?.error?.({ err: err.message }, '[SYSTEM-NOTIFY] send failed') if logger is provided, then respond 500 { ok:false, error: err.message }. Default export an object { createSystemNotifyRoutes }. No other routes, no other files.
non_goals: logging or returning the raw token
